title.narrative: Strategic Management Support for the Guyana-Norway Portfolio

description.narrative: The objective is to provide ongoing strategic support for the active projects funded through the GRIF to increase the effectiveness of the implementation of the Guyana-Norway Partnership Programme to ensure improved monitoring of outcomes of GRIF-funded activities in Guyana and reporting on impacts leading to positive development outcomes

The project will allow GGGI to continue to provide the Government of Guyana and donor-Norway with support to successfully administer and close out the projects and activities being delivered under the Guyana REDD+ Investment Fund (GRIF), which is set to conclude at the end of 2026. The project will resource GGGI work to ensure that GRIF projects are on a successful path towards project delivery, that projects are adequately monitored and reporting results effectively, and that the relevant governance bodies are functioning in a robust manner. The project is demand driven, with both governments of Guyana and Norway expressing strong support for GGGI to continue assisting GRIF implementation. The project will build on phase I (GY05) learnings and best practices.
